articles.title: Layer Effects: Bevel Enabled
articles.summary: Layer Effects: turns the Bevel effect on or off for the layer. It is an on/off switch.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > right column > layer list > double-click a layer > Layer Effects dialog.
when: Add a shadow, glow, outline, tint or bevel to a logo / number layer without editing its pixels.
how: Click to switch it on or off.

controls.label: Layer Effects: Bevel Enabled
